_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for every host manifest in this repo.
Edit this file, then run: node scripts/build-manifests.mjs
Never hand-edit the generated files listed in scripts/build-manifests.mjs.
CI runs the generator with --check and fails if the committed files drift.

descriptions.claude: Cross-tool, cross-project memory for Claude Code, Codex CLI, and GitHub Copilot CLI, powered by Empirical.
descriptions.copilot: Cross-tool, cross-project memory and optional workflow plugins, powered by Empirical.

plugins.name: empirical-memory
plugins.entryDescription: Core Empirical memory and MCP connection across coding agents.

descriptions.claude: Cross-tool, cross-project memory for Claude Code. Start an idea in ChatGPT, pick it up in Claude with full context carried over. Track leads and relationships as durable memory instead of a separate CRM. Organize memory into separate workspaces for personal, team, or client contexts. Recalls prior decisions and conventions across sessions, and persists new ones as you work.
descriptions.codex: Cross-tool, cross-project memory for Codex CLI. Start an idea in ChatGPT, pick it up in Codex with full context carried over. Track leads and relationships as durable memory instead of a separate CRM. Organize memory into separate workspaces for personal, team, or client contexts. Recalls prior decisions and conventions across sessions, and persists new ones as you work.

catalog.shortDescription: Portable memory across AI tools and projects.
catalog.longDescription: Carry durable context, decisions, preferences, and work history across Claude Code, Codex CLI, GitHub Copilot CLI, and ChatGPT.
defaultPrompt: Recall relevant context for this project.
Save this decision to Empirical memory.
